name: Return to the Magistrate
summary: At Brill, Magistrate Sevren receives a warning from the eastern frontier. Deathguard Linnea sends word that the Lich King's mindless servants still test the Forsaken borders.

sections.title: Frontier Reports
sections.body: East of Tirisfal Glades, the road reaches the blighted ruins of the Western Plaguelands, where the Scourge holds sway. The Forsaken built the Bulwark to keep the undead from entering their homeland. Deathguard Linnea watches from a waystation behind the line, gathering reports from the eastern gate. She sends messengers west along the King's Road to Brill before enemy infiltrators can exploit gaps in the defenses.

sections.title: Sevren's Vow
sections.body: In Brill, Magistrate Sevren hears that Scourge scouts are finding paths around or through the frontline. Each creeping ghoul and mindless skeleton recalls the Forsaken's enslavement, broken when Lordaeron fell. Sevren vows that no matter how ceaseless the Lich King's assault, the free undead will not surrender their new autonomy.

faq.q: Where does this report come from?
faq.answer: Deathguard Linnea sends the report from her waystation east of Brill, on the road to the Bulwark. She gathers word from the barricades between Tirisfal and the Scourge-held Western Plaguelands.

faq.q: Why is Magistrate Sevren concerned about this news?
faq.answer: The dispatch warns Sevren that Scourge forces have slipped past the Bulwark's fortifications. Their incursions threaten the Forsaken's young towns and recall the Lich King's effort to reclaim them.
Magistrate Sevren administers Brill from its town hall. He oversees local defenses, infrastructure, and the mustering of newly raised Forsaken across central Tirisfal Glades.
The Bulwark is a fortified outpost on the main road between Tirisfal Glades and the Western Plaguelands. It bars Scourge incursions into Forsaken lands.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken hate the Scourge so much?
faq.answer: The Forsaken were once the Scourge's mindless thralls, slain in life and raised to butcher their own kin. Now free-willed, they hate the Lich King and fear falling under his control again.

faq.q: What path does this message travel?
faq.answer: Messengers carry the message west from Deathguard Linnea's waystation along the main road, through central Tirisfal Glades, to Brill's town center.

angles.text: As an Undead, you know how fragile Forsaken freedom remains: the master you escaped still presses against your new home.
As a member of the Horde, you know Tirisfal Glades anchors your foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms. The Bulwark guards it from the horrors of the Plaguelands.
